narr: Thunderstorms developed during the early morning over Pima County and caused areas of flash flooding. Additional storms developed during the afternoon across Graham County, move southwest, and produced severe wind gusts and flash flooding in the Safford area.
ev: Two to four inches of rain in two hours fell over the higher terrain north of Safford and Pima. Flash flooding caused multiple road washouts of Safford-Bryce and Bryce-Eden Rds.
One hour rainfall of 0.5 to 1 on ground saturated from rain the previous day caused flash flooding northeast of Ryan Field and the closure of Snyder Hill Rd west of San Joaquin Rd.
Two inches of rain in 2 hours north of Three Points caused flooding of roadways west of Picture Rocks. A vehicle was stranded in floodwaters on Tucker Road at the Blanco Wash.
lsr: CORRECTS PREVIOUS FLASH FLOOD REPORT FROM 7 NW TUCSON. FIRE DEPARTMENT REPORTED 3 STRANDED DRIVERS IN THE AREA OF FAIRVIEW AVE, PARIS PROMENADE AVE, AND GRANT RD.
SHERIFF REPORTED MULTIPLE WASHOUTS AND/OR DEBRIS ACROSS THE THE SAFFORD-BRYCE ROAD AND THE N BRYCE-EDEN ROAD.
